{{Quote|Miy'til squadron, hold your fire! We're the good guys!|Han Solo to Aegel Squadron|<ref name="apocalypse" />}}
'''Aegel Squadron''' served in the [[Hapan Royal Navy]] in [[44 ABY]]. The [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] consisted of [[Hapan]] [[Miy'til starfighter]]s, and they assisted the [[New Jedi Order]] during the [[Evacuation of Ossus (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|evacuation]] from the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] after the [[Jedi academy|academy]] came under attack by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]. During the evacuation, the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] strayed into the free-fire zone, prompting Aegel Squadron into firing. Hapan agent [[Taryn Zel]], who was aboard the ''Millennium Falcon'', sent a message in ancient [[Lorellian language|Lorellian]] to the [[Unidentified officer of Aegel Squadron|officer]] of the Aegels and quickly cleared the misunderstanding.<ref name="apocalypse" />
